Games Action Games Grand Theft Auto GTA 6 For 5 days, this PlayStation Store credit deal brings GTA 6's $100 Ultimate Edition down to the price of a normal game News By Austin Wood Published 6 October 2026 PlayStation Store gift cards are available at a rare discount When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here's how it works . (Image credit: Rockstar) Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter PlayStation users can get $100 in PSN store credit for $80 using a limited-time offer available to Costco members. Costco is selling four $25 PlayStation Store gift cards for $79.99 with an exclusive membership discount, offering a solid 20% saving. This price will only show up to members who are signed in. Each Costco member can only claim this deal twice, and it will only be available until Sunday, October 11 or "while supplies last." Once purchased, the digital download codes will be delivered by email and must be redeemed via the PlayStation Store. Latest Videos From GamesRadar+ Watch full video here: With GTA 6 being the highest-profile game release of the year, fans of Rockstar's open-world games quickly clocked that this deal brings the price of the game's $100 Ultimate Edition down to the new normal $80 ceiling for normal AAA games, which GTA 6's standard edition shares. It's still costly for one new game, but it's hard to save money on GTA 6 elsewhere, as Rockstar won't officially discount it for some time. You may like Take-Two boss says GTA 6's $100 Ultimate Edition is outselling its cheaper alternative Where to pre-order GTA 6: bundles, discounts, and fastest delivery times compared I'm building the ultimate GTA 6 setup this Prime Day, these are the gadgets in my cart Provided you're already a Costco member and aren't the US government, this sort of digital markdown is about as close as you can get to printing money. However, with the basic gold star Costco membership going for $65 a year, joining now just for this deal doesn't math out. Whether the store's grocery and hotdog benefits are worth the price is up for you to decide. This discount comes as Prime Day PS5 deals slash prices on a range of consoles and games that we've been tracking.
